title: {Syn} Grover Algorithm Gives Quadratic Search Speedup
content:
Grover algorithm can search an unstructured space of size N in about square root of N queries on a quantum computer.

It is powerful but not magic: the speedup is quadratic, not exponential, which still matters for brute-force security estimates.

Why it matters: algorithms keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
